Use Renjin (pure JVM R interpreter) for the R processor to avoid native dependencies and allow in-process execution within the JVM.
Implement the Hive sink using Hive JDBC/HCatalog to write data in configurable batches with schema mapping.
Upgrade the project to Spring Core 4.1.1 milestone, replacing deprecated APIs while maintaining compatibility with existing Spring XD modules.

Implement a shared ACL service that stores stream resource permissions (create/destroy/view) and enforce it in both the DSL Shell and Admin UI backend.
